title: Fewest fuel stops on a highway run
insight: LeetCode 871 Minimum Number of Refueling Stops: drive as far as possible, keep passed stations in a max-heap, and when stranded take the largest fuel seen so far, O(n log n)
prompt: Please finish MinRefuelStops in refuel.go for the route planner. README.md defines the station format, the exact reachability rule and the half-million-station requirement. Don't change the package name or the exported signature, stick to the standard library, and make sure `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` pass when you're done.
